## Summary
Build **StockRoom** from scratch as a two-service monorepo: a NestJS 11 + Prisma 7 (Postgres) JWT-authed API and an Angular 22 SPA, containerised behind nginx and deployed via the existing Colossus workflow.

## Scope

Repo is greenfield — 2 commits, only `README.md` and `.github/workflows/colossus-deploy.yml`. No `ATLAS_STACK.md`, no `<project_config>`, no `k8s/`, no `.claude/scopes/`. Everything below is new; nothing existing is modified except `README.md`.

### Files to modify
- `README.md` — replace stub with run/deploy instructions and demo credentials.

### Files to create

**Backend — `backend/`**
- `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `.env.example`, `Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore`
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — datamodel + generator
- `prisma/seed.ts` — idempotent seed (2 users, 3 locations, 8 items, stock levels)
- `src/main.ts` — bootstrap, global `/api` prefix, `ValidationPipe({whitelist, transform})`
- `src/app.module.ts`
- `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`
- `src/auth/` — `auth.module.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `roles.guard.ts`, `roles.decorator.ts`, `current-user.decorator.ts`, `dto/login.dto.ts`, `dto/signup.dto.ts`
- `src/items/` — `items.module.ts`, `items.service.ts`, `items.controller.ts`, `dto/create-item.dto.ts`, `dto/update-item.dto.ts`, `dto/query-items.dto.ts`
- `src/locations/` — module, service, controller, `dto/create-location.dto.ts`, `dto/update-location.dto.ts`
- `src/movements/` — module, service, controller, `dto/create-movement.dto.ts`, `dto/query-movements.dto.ts`
- `src/reports/` — `reports.module.ts`, `reports.service.ts`, `reports.controller.ts`
- `src/health/health.controller.ts`, `health.module.ts`
- `test/` — e2e specs (auth, movements, rbac)

**Frontend — `frontend/`**
- `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore`, `nginx.conf`
- `src/index.html` — `<title>StockRoom</title>` + app-shell brand markup

- `src/app/features/items/` — `item-list.component.ts`, `item-detail.component.ts`, `item-form.component.ts`
- `src/app/features/locations/` — `location-list.component.ts`, `location-form.component.ts`

- `docker-compose.yml` — postgres 17, api, web

### Dependencies
- **Backend:** `@nestjs/{common,core,platform-express,config,jwt,passport}@^11`, `passport`, `passport-jwt`, `bcrypt`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`, `prisma`/`@prisma/client`@^7. Dev: `typescript`, `ts-node`, `jest`, `supertest`, `@nestjs/testing`.
- **Frontend:** `@angular/*`@^22 (standalone, signals), `rxjs`. No UI kit — hand-rolled SCSS to avoid version drift.
- **Runtime:** Node 24 LTS, PostgreSQL 17.

**Version pinning is deliberate.** `prisma@latest` currently resolves to an `8.0.0-rc`; NestJS 12 (Aug 2026) is ESM-first and interops poorly with CJS tooling. Pin NestJS `^11`, Prisma `^7`, Angular `^22` — the mutually-compatible stable set.

### Integrations
None. The spec declares no third-party APIs, SDKs, or external services.

### Assumptions
- **Greenfield.** No stack to conform to; the spec's NestJS/Prisma/Angular/JWT stack is authoritative.
- **Auth model = `full_auth`** (clerk + manager are non-admin authenticated actors). Login, signup, logout, route guards. Public: `/login`, `/signup`, `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`.
- **Signup role:** `manager` only when the user table is empty, else `clerk`. With seeds present this always yields `clerk`, satisfying both the auth baseline and the spec's seeded-manager model.
- **Low-stock predicate:** `SUM(qty) <= reorderAt`. Satisfies both spec scenarios (7≤10 listed, 40≤10 not).
- **JWT in `localStorage`**, `Authorization: Bearer`, 12h expiry — the standard Angular/NestJS pattern named in the spec's non-functional section.
- **Movements are immutable** — no edit/delete endpoint; corrections are compensating movements. The spec defines no mutation path and an editable audit log is self-defeating.
- **`unit`, `zone`** are free-text strings; `reorderAt`/`qty` are non-negative integers.
- **Emails** are `clerk@demo` / `manager@demo` verbatim (not RFC-valid) — validate with `IsString`, not `IsEmail`.
- Single-origin deployment: nginx serves the SPA and reverse-proxies `/api` to the API, so no CORS config is needed.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Repo scaffold
**Files:** root `.gitignore`, `README.md`
Two workspaces, `backend/` and `frontend/`. Ignore `node_modules`, `dist`, `.env`, `backend/src/generated`.

### Step 2: Prisma schema
**File:** `backend/prisma/schema.prisma`
```prisma
generator client {
  provider            = "prisma-client"
  output              = "../src/generated/prisma"
  moduleFormat        = "cjs"
  importFileExtension = "js"
}
```
Prisma 7 **requires** `output` and defaults to ESM — `moduleFormat = "cjs"` is mandatory for CJS NestJS. Import `PrismaClient` from `src/generated/prisma`, never `@prisma/client`.

Models: `User(id, email @unique, passwordHash, role Role, createdAt)`; `enum Role {clerk manager}`; `Item(id, sku @unique, name, description?, unit, reorderAt Int, createdAt)`; `Location(id, name, zone, createdAt)`; `StockLevel(id, itemId, locationId, qty Int @default(0))` with `@@unique([itemId, locationId])`; `Movement(id, type MovementType, itemId, fromLocId?, toLocId?, qty Int, note?, userId, createdAt)`; `enum MovementType {IN OUT TRANSFER}`. Index `Movement` on `[itemId, createdAt]` and `[createdAt]` for the filterable log. `@@unique` on `Item.sku` is what enforces the duplicate-SKU scenario at the DB level.

### Step 3: Prisma service + health
**Files:** `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`, `src/health/health.controller.ts`
`PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit`. `GET /api/health` → `{status:'ok'}`; `GET /api/health/deep` → runs `SELECT 1`, returns 503 on failure. Both `@Public()`.

### Step 4: Auth
**Files:** `src/auth/*`
`AuthService.validateUser` with `bcrypt.compare` (cost 10). `POST /api/auth/login` → `{accessToken, user:{id,email,role}}`; 401 on bad credentials. `POST /api/auth/signup`. `GET /api/auth/me`. `POST /api/auth/logout` (204; client discards token).
Register `JwtAuthGuard` as a **global** `APP_GUARD` with a `@Public()` metadata escape hatch — this makes "unauthenticated → 401 on any data endpoint" the default rather than something each controller opts into. `RolesGuard` reads `@Roles('manager')` and throws 403.

### Step 5: Items
**Files:** `src/items/*`
`GET /api/items` (any role) returns each item plus `totalQty` (summed `StockLevel`), supporting `?q=&lowOnly=&page=&pageSize=`. `GET /api/items/:id` returns the item plus per-location breakdown. `POST/PATCH/DELETE` are `@Roles('manager')`. Catch Prisma `P2002` on `sku` → 409/422 validation error. Block deleting an item that has non-zero stock or movements.

### Step 6: Locations
**Files:** `src/locations/*`
`GET /api/locations` (any role, needed to populate the movement form). `POST/PATCH/DELETE` manager-only. Block deleting a location holding stock.

### Step 7: Movements — the atomicity core
**File:** `src/movements/movements.service.ts`
Validate per type: `IN` requires `toLocId` only; `OUT` requires `fromLocId` only; `TRANSFER` requires both and they must differ; `qty` must be an integer ≥ 1.

Wrap every write in `prisma.$transaction`. For decrements, use a **conditional update** rather than read-then-write:
```ts
const r = await tx.stockLevel.updateMany({
  where: { itemId, locationId: fromLocId, qty: { gte: qty } },
  data:  { qty: { decrement: qty } },
});
if (r.count !== 1) throw new UnprocessableEntityException('Insufficient stock');
```
This makes the over-draw check race-safe under concurrency and guarantees the "balance remains 5" scenario, since the transaction aborts before any `Movement` row is written. Increments use `upsert` (create-at-qty or increment). `TRANSFER` performs the guarded decrement then the increment in the same transaction, conserving the total.

`GET /api/movements` is manager-only, ordered `createdAt desc`, joined to user/item/location names, filterable by `?itemId=&type=&from=&to=&userId=&page=`.

### Step 8: Low-stock report
**File:** `src/reports/reports.service.ts`
`GET /api/reports/low-stock`, manager-only. Aggregate `StockLevel` by item and return those with `totalQty <= reorderAt`, including `totalQty`, `reorderAt` and shortfall, sorted by shortfall desc.

### Step 9: Seed
**File:** `backend/prisma/seed.ts`
Idempotent `upsert`s: `manager@demo` / `clerk@demo` (both `Demo1234!`, bcrypt-hashed); 3 locations (`Zone A`, `Zone B`, `Zone C`); 8 items `SKU-001`…`SKU-008` with varied `reorderAt`; opening `StockLevel` rows deliberately leaving 2–3 items at or below threshold so the low-stock report is non-empty on first load. Run as `prisma migrate deploy && node dist/prisma/seed.js` in the container entrypoint.

### Step 10: Angular shell, routing and the smoke marker
**Files:** `src/index.html`, `src/app/app.routes.ts`, `src/app/shared/shell.component.ts`
Put `StockRoom` in `<title>` **and** as static markup inside `<app-root>` in `index.html`, so the name is in the DOM before Angular bootstraps and survives the unauthenticated `/` → `/login` redirect. The login page and the authenticated shell header also render the brand.

Routes — every navigable state addressable, each with a `data.flow` node:
- `/login`, `/signup` — public
- `/` → redirect to `/items`
- `/items` — `?q=&lowOnly=&sort=&page=`
- `/items/new`, `/items/:id/edit` — manager
- `/items/:id` — `?tab=stock|history`
- `/locations`, `/locations/new`, `/locations/:id/edit` — manager
- `/movements/new` — `?type=IN|OUT|TRANSFER&itemId=&fromLocId=&toLocId=`
- `/movements` — manager; `?itemId=&type=&from=&to=&page=`
- `/reports/low-stock` — manager
- Destructive confirms as `?modal=delete&id=` — no buried component state.

All non-public routes carry `authGuard`; manager routes add `roleGuard(['manager'])`. List/log components read filters from `route.queryParamMap` and write them back via `router.navigate({queryParams})`, so every filtered view is deep-linkable.

### Step 11: Angular core services
**Files:** `src/app/core/*`
`AuthService` with a `currentUser` signal hydrated from `localStorage`. `authInterceptor` attaches the bearer token and redirects to `/login?returnUrl=` on 401. Nav hides manager-only links by role — with the server-side `RolesGuard` as the real enforcement.

### Step 12: Feature components
Item list (SKU, name, unit, reorderAt, total on hand); item detail (per-location breakdown whose sum equals the total, plus movement history tab); item and location forms with inline server-validation errors (duplicate SKU); movement form that switches location fields by type and surfaces the insufficient-stock error; audit log table with item/type/date-range filters; low-stock report.

### Step 13: Containerisation
**Files:** `backend/Dockerfile`, `frontend/Dockerfile`, `frontend/nginx.conf`, `docker-compose.yml`
Backend: multi-stage Node 24 alpine — install, `prisma generate` **before** `nest build`, then a slim runtime stage carrying `dist/`, `prisma/` and production `node_modules`.
Frontend: build stage runs `ng build`, then
```dockerfile
COPY --from=build /app/dist/stockroom-web/browser /usr/share/nginx/html
```
Angular 17+ emits to `dist/<app>/browser` — copying `dist/stockroom-web` alone ships a directory listing, not the app. `nginx.conf` needs `try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;` for deep links and `location /api { proxy_pass http://api:3000; }` for single-origin.

### Step 14: K8s manifests
**Files:** `k8s/*.yaml`
Postgres StatefulSet + PVC; API Deployment with `DATABASE_URL`/`JWT_SECRET` from a Secret, readiness probe on `/api/health/deep`, liveness on `/api/health`; web Deployment + Service; Ingress routing `/` to web. Migrations and seed run in an init container.

## Testing Strategy
- **Unit:** `MovementsService` — each type's field validation; over-draw rejection leaves balance untouched; transfer conserves total.
- **E2E (supertest, test DB):** unauthenticated call to every data endpoint → 401; clerk POST `/api/items` → 403; duplicate SKU → validation error with exactly one row stored; IN 50 → balance 50; OUT 20 → 30; TRANSFER 10 → 20/10 with unchanged total; OUT 10 against 5 → error and balance still 5; low-stock includes the 12→7 item and excludes the 40-unit item; audit log filters by item and date range.
- **Manual/Playwright:** load `/` unauthenticated → sign-in view renders and contains `StockRoom` (the smoke oracle); sign in as each demo account and confirm the role-appropriate navigation.
- **Build gate:** `docker compose up --build` from clean, then hit `/api/health/deep` and the root page.

## Risks
- **Smoke oracle timing.** The Playwright check asserts `StockRoom` on the unauthenticated root, which redirects. Mitigated by baking the brand into `index.html`'s app-shell so it never depends on bootstrap or redirect timing — verify this before considering the task done.
- **Prisma 7 client generation.** The client is generated into `src/generated/` and gitignored; any build that skips `prisma generate` before `nest build` fails with unresolved imports. Wire it into the Docker build and a `postinstall`/`prebuild` script.
- **Version drift.** `prisma@latest` resolves to an 8.x RC and NestJS 12 is ESM-first. Pin caret ranges on `^7` and `^11`; do not run an unpinned `npm install` of these.
- **Angular dist path.** `dist/<app>/browser` — the single most common cause of an nginx image serving an empty page.
- **Race conditions.** Concurrent OUT movements are safe only via the conditional `updateMany` guard; a read-then-write implementation would allow negative balances under load.
- **Seed idempotency.** The seed runs on every deploy; it must `upsert` on natural keys (email, sku, location name) or restarts will duplicate the catalog.
